zz_test_fixture_projects.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE (slug LIKE 'zz-%' OR slug LIKE '_enum%' OR title LIKE 'zz-%' OR title LIKE '_ENUM%') AND deleted_at IS NULL
zz_test_fixture_projects.note: Intentional test-fixture residuals; validator-safe. These rows carry no active outbox mutations from PB, have no tasks pointing at them, and are not referenced by any Hub UI path that runs validators. 32 of 34 zz-test projects were cleaned in Phase 5; these 2 were created in a later characterization-test batch and not yet soft-deleted. They do not trip enum/triad/conflict/dedup validators on deploy.

task_status_enum_drift.correction: Original query used the PB brain.db status set (omitting 'blocked' and 'waiting_external'). Hub D1 canonical task statuses per api/enum-domains.generated.json:169-176 are: todo, in_progress, done, blocked, waiting_external, deleted. 'blocked' is canonical — the flagged row has zero drift.
task_status_enum_drift.original_query_was_wrong: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status NOT IN ('todo','in_progress','done','deleted','waiting','idea','someday','cancelled') AND deleted_at IS NULL

previously_flagged_row.verdict: NOT drift — 'blocked' is in the Hub D1 canonical set (enum-domains.generated.json:174)

project_stage_enum_drift.note: Projects table does not have a 'stage' column in D1 (confirmed: no such column error). The stage field lives only in brain.db (PB-only cache). No D1 stage enum drift possible.

orphan_tasks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.id = t.project_id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
orphan_tasks.note: Pre-existing class, no validator risk. All 599 orphan tasks reference legacy slug-format project_ids (e.g. 'admin-tasks', not 'proj_{ulid}'). These predate the proj_{ulid} migration and are NOT a result of Phase 5 cleanup. The mutations validator does not check FK integrity against projects for task updates — it validates enum domains, completion triads, and hash/seq conflicts, none of which are affected by a missing project row. The slug-to-ulid re-linking is a separate pre-existing backlog item.
